news.summary: The Raiders' second-year pro, a sixth overall pick in 2025, suffered a low ankle sprain on August 23 during an 11-on-11 drill but returned to full practice this week. Listed as a full participant, Jeanty told reporters he feels great and never doubted playing Sunday against the Miami Dolphins at Allegiant Stadium. While he'll share some early carries with rookie Mike Washington Jr., his return boosts the offense under new coach Klint Kubiak and QB Kirk Cousins—though All-Pro TE Brock Bowers will miss time after knee surgery.

news.hook: Eight months after tearing his Achilles in the playoffs, George Kittle is back on the field tonight, ready to block and catch for the 49ers in Australia.
news.name: George Kittle Cleared to Play in 49ers Season Opener After Achilles Tear
news.summary: The San Francisco 49ers tight end suffered the injury during their wild-card win over the Eagles on January 11 and beat the typical nine-to-12-month recovery with intense rehab, including heavy lifting and on-field drills. He's now off the injury report alongside returns from Nick Bosa, Fred Warner, Dre Greenlaw, and Deebo Samuel, boosting the team's lineup for the historic NFL opener at Melbourne Cricket Ground against the Rams. Fans are thrilled with the injury-free good news, though coach Kyle Shanahan plans to manage Kittle's snaps carefully in his 10th season.

news.hook: Brock Bowers, the Raiders' young tight end sensation, stepped up for a quick meniscus trim in Dallas — a move that means he'll sit out the season opener against Miami.
news.name: Raiders Star Brock Bowers Out 1-2 Games After Meniscus Surgery
news.summary: The All-Pro rookie from 2024 underwent the procedure Tuesday after a camp injury, with recovery typically taking 4-6 weeks but the team hoping for just a game or two. Coach Klint Kubiak had sounded optimistic hours earlier, expecting Bowers ready for Sunday. Fourth-year tight end Michael Mayer steps up in his place, as the Raiders host Miami in Week 1 and travel to face the Chargers in Week 2. At 23, Bowers aims for a Week 3 return, building on his stellar rookie year of 112 catches despite a prior knee issue last season.

news.hook: Blake Bortles grabs a sledgehammer in hard hat and vest, ready to fire up the crowd with the Jaguars' signature chant before Sunday's home opener.
news.name: Blake Bortles Returns to Lead Jaguars' First DUUUVAL Chant for Home Opener
news.summary: The Jacksonville Jaguars build hype for their 2026 home opener against the Cleveland Browns with a fun 'Jags at Work' theme, bringing back former quarterback Blake Bortles to lead the 'First DUUUVAL' chant at EverBank Stadium. Bortles, who played five seasons from 2014-18, holds franchise records for single-season passing touchdowns and guided the team to the 2017 AFC Championship Game. Fans show strong excitement online amid stadium renovations and local pride, as the Jags defend their AFC South title from a 13-4 season.

news.hook: Joe Burrow sat down for a candid interview and drew a clear line: he's staying put in Cincinnati, ready to lead with a championship drive.
news.name: Joe Burrow Commits to Bengals for the Long Haul
news.summary: In an exclusive Bengals.com interview, quarterback Joe Burrow clarified his summer 'now or never' comments were about daily urgency, not leaving the team. 'I’m here for the long haul. I’m not going anywhere,' he said, expressing pride in representing Cincinnati, Ohio, and the Bengals organization. Signed through 2029, the seventh-year pro heads into Sunday's home opener against the Buccaneers with renewed mobility after toe surgery and a focus on playoff success.

news.hook: Zay Flowers lit up practice drills this week, declaring he feels better than ever after his hamstring tweak. It's a welcome sight for Baltimore fans as the team gears up for their season debut.
news.name: Ravens Share Positive Injury Updates Before Colts Opener
news.summary: The Ravens' early injury reports show four key players limited in Wednesday's practice: wide receivers Zay Flowers (hamstring) and Devontez Walker (groin), linebacker Teddye Buchanan (knee), and defensive lineman Nnamdi Madubuike (neck). Flowers upgraded to full participation in Thursday's estimated report, while the others stayed limited, with every roster player suiting up—a strong sign under new coach Jesse Minter. The Colts also reported limited players like Alec Pierce (heel), but several upgraded to full, setting up a healthy matchup at Lucas Oil Stadium on Sunday.

news.hook: After practice, head coach Sean Payton called together the nine players voted captains by their peers—a group blending steady vets with one fresh face.
news.name: Broncos Name Nine Team Captains Led by Bo Nix for 2026 Season
news.summary: The Denver Broncos announced their 2026 captains: quarterback Bo Nix for his third straight year, wide receiver Courtland Sutton in his sixth consecutive season, guard Quinn Meinerz, cornerback Pat Surtain II, safety Talanoa Hufanga, defensive tackle D.J. Jones, inside linebacker Alex Singleton, kicker Wil Lutz, and newcomer special teams ace Devon Key. Nix called it a special honor from teammates, while Sutton expressed deep gratitude and noted leadership opportunities for all. Payton praised their diverse styles, as the team gears up for the opener against the Kansas City Chiefs—with Nix fully recovered and ready to lead.

news.hook: Myles Garrett steps onto the field in a Rams jersey for the first time, leaving longtime Browns fans torn between old loyalties and new rivalries.
news.name: Browns Fans Divided on Rooting for Myles Garrett with Rams
news.summary: The star edge rusher, fresh off a June 1 trade from Cleveland to Los Angeles, debuts today against the 49ers at Melbourne Cricket Ground. Rams fans buzz with excitement over pairing him with Aaron Donald, while many Browns supporters say no to cheering him on, citing team allegiance and the draft picks they gained in the deal that sent Jared Verse and high selections their way. A few wish him well personally but prioritize Cleveland's future, highlighting the trade's lasting impact on both fanbases.

news.hook: San Francisco 49ers supporters from California to the UK lit up with game-day joy on September 10, 2026, as the team geared up for its season debut against the Rams Down Under.
news.name: 49ers Fans Buzz for Historic NFL Opener in Melbourne
news.summary: The 49ers face the Rams at Melbourne Cricket Ground in the NFL's first regular-season game in Australia, kicking off at 8:35 p.m. ET on Netflix with the Rams as the home team. Fans shared hyped posts like 'IT’S GAMEDAY FAITHFUL!!!!!!! #FTTB' and 'THE 49ERS PLAY FOOTBALL TONIGHT! we made it, faithful 🥹,' marking 214 days since the last regular-season action. Both teams arrived early to beat jet lag after strong 2025 seasons, with first place in the NFC West on the line in this global showdown.
